newsitem.title: CHINA: Half foreign firms in Shanghai evade tax-paper.
newsitem.headline: Half foreign firms in Shanghai evade tax-paper.

text.p: Nearly half of the foreign-invested firms in Shanghai are evading tax payments, costing the city hundreds of millions of yuan, the Business Times said on Thursday.

Of the more than 5,000 registered foreign firms in Shanghai, only 2,807 have also registered to pay tax, indicating nearly 50 percent of them had so far paid no tax at all, the newspaper quoted local tax officials as saying.
In the first three months of this year, the Shanghai local government collected a total of 4.077 billion yuan in taxes from foreigners, an increase of 42.05 percent year-on-year, the newspaper said.
